newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil Celesc still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil Celesc still a hold.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it was maintaining its hold rating on Brazilian power utility Celesc .
-- Analysts Gilbert Casillas and Victor Moraes said in a report that they noted the company in a general sense is undervalued.

-- But reiterated that "the market will demand a commitment toward fairer and more transparent management than that currently being demonstrated in order to rerate the stock in line with market multiples."

-- also said it seems unlikely that the current state government will privatize the company. Celesc is controlled by the southern state of Santa Catarina, whose governor is currently facing an impeachment process.
-- Celesc has recently released its first quarter results. It reported a net income of 18.7 million reais between January and March.
-- Celesc "B" preferred was off 0.65 percent at 1.52 reais at 1620 local/1920 GMT on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
